summary: Deletion review dialog, per-folder conflict resolver, specific attention reasons, embedded Add Account wizard and icon/guard fixes.
changelog: Folder rows in 'Review Deletions' open a dialog with Keep Paused, Restore from Nextcloud, Approve These Deletions Once and the server trash browser (issue #105).
Disabling the deletion guard now clears a pending alert in place, without a restart (issue #104).
The per-folder options menu opens the conflict resolver for that specific folder (issue #110).
'Account Needs Attention' now says whether credentials were rejected or none are saved (issue #95).
Add Account is embedded in the main window instead of a separate window (issue #97).
Folder rows no longer show 'Synchronized' twice, and the connection icon is larger and clearer (issues #108, #109).
